public_view.revision: integer; sent back with every action

dice.value: 1..6; determines face using the hero dice_faces array

abilities.name: string
abilities.cost: 0; abilities are activated by their dice pattern
abilities.condition: counts of symbols or straight length

pending_attack.lifesteal: optional boolean; Blood Power heals the attacker by resolved attack damage, after return damage and before ability effects

public_view.hero_catalog: object keyed by hero id; public name/name_zh/icon/subtitle/dice_faces/symbol_icons/symbol_names/abilities/defense/season (1 or 2)
public_view.status_catalog: object keyed by status id; public name/name_zh/icon/limit/description/positive/companion
public_view.turn_player: player whose turn is in progress, including during a defensive response
public_view.roll_limit: integer; current maximum roll attempts after cards/statuses
public_view.defense_dice: public array of value/face from the most recent defense

defense_result.nullable: null until a normal Defend roll; retained through main_2, round_review and game_over; cleared by new turn/offense/attack or defensive Pass
defense_result.dice: array of value/face objects from this defense roll
defense_result.attack_damage: attack damage before cards, defense roll and statuses
defense_result.prevented: damage blocked by the defense roll's direct prevention/halving only, after prior card prevention; excludes status mitigation
defense_result.healing: actual capped HP gained from this roll before damage settlement
defense_result.cp_gained: actual capped CP gained from this roll
defense_result.status_gains: object mapping status ids to actual capped stack gains from this roll, including stacks immediately consumed during settlement
defense_result.damage_taken: resolved incoming damage after all mitigation, matching combat damage accounting; not capped to remaining HP
defense_result.returned_damage: sum of resolved return damage from defense, Retribution and pending attack return sources after attacker mitigation; not capped to remaining HP

privacy: Per-player hidden deck/discard orders, opponent hand identities, seed and RNG state are omitted from public_view. Catalogs and public logs contain no private cards.
rules_scope: Twelve playable hero identities: all eight Season One Rerolled heroes plus Season Two Gunslinger, Samurai, Vampire Lord and Seraph. This is a simplified digital adaptation: dice distributions, abilities, abbreviated decks/upgrades and automatic status/companion spending are local rules, not printed card-for-card parity. Blood Power automatically chooses damage or lifesteal, Mesmerize checks at opponent roll confirmation, and Flight is defensive only. Other printed token options and passive abilities are not included.
